items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: Doc had called me on long distance phone and told me, asked me how I'm ready if I wanted to come by plane or by train... So he sent me a ticket and I went on out there... So I played out there six weeks with Earl.

ctx.x: Yeah. I can't think of his name.

I can't think of his name. He's a little Jewish fella. I can't think of his name right now. But anyhow we made a couple of engagements for him. We played at the Tin Angel in San Francisco. Oh yeah. We played that about three times, nine months in all. Then we played for, for Doc Dorothy at the Hangover. Yeah. Played for him a couple of times.
That was when Lizzie Miles and Joe Robertson came out there. That's right, yeah.
